summary.text: Son of Triopas and brother of Iasus in Pausanias' native Argive succession; father of Crotopus, whose line held Argos until Danaus interrupted the kingdom of Agenor's descendants.
Not Agenor son of Poseidon and Libya who ruled Phoenicia and begat Cadmus and Europa, nor the Aetolian, Trojan, Ithacan, or Zacynthian homonyms elsewhere in the genealogies.

story.text: Pausanias' Argive king-list makes Triopas begat Iasus and Agenor. After Iasus' reign, Crotopus son of Agenor came to the throne and begat Sthenelas; Danaus later sailed from Egypt against Gelanor son of Sthenelas and stayed the succession to the kingdom of Agenor's descendants.
